svg.title: Machine display — Fill, flavor 1 selected
svg.desc: Big Blue Fill page. Flavor 1 is selected in the left rail, its cell pale with an orange ring and a check, and shown in the portrait captioned On tap. Back stands over the task, which reads: Fill this flavor. Top it up. Pour concentrate into the top funnel. The orange button reads Start filling. The portraits are the factory Flavor 1 and Flavor 2 artwork.
